source.author: verg
source.text: vitam oro, patior quemvis durare laborem.
source.text_original: vitam oro, patior quemvis durare laborem.
source.text_english: By your life, I pray, I am willing to endure any toil whatsoever.

reuse.author: val
reuse.text: si fata reducunt te mihi, si trepidis placabile matribus aequor, possum equidem lucemque pati longumque timorem.
reuse.text_original: si fata reducunt / te mihi, si trepidis placabile matribus aequor, / possum equidem lucemque pati longumque timorem.
reuse.text_english: if the fates bring you back to me, if the sea can be calmed for trembling mothers, I can indeed endure both the daylight and the long fear.
